name: generate_music
description: Generate a music clip from a text prompt via Gemini Lyria or ElevenLabs. Generation step — produces a file on disk; composition happens at render time.

output.description: Path to the generated music clip (plus, with --json: seconds, vendorSeconds, trimmed, note)

params.name: prompt
params.description: Text description of the music (genre, mood, instrumentation, BPM)

params.name: out
params.description: Output audio file path. The extension is advisory — the file is named after the container the vendor actually returns (mp3 in practice), never re-encoded to match. Read the emitted path rather than assuming this one. Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.

params.name: vendor
params.description: Music vendor to use. ElevenLabs music needs their paid plan.

params.name: model
params.description: Override the vendor's default model (Gemini default: lyria-3.5, ~68s tracks)

params.name: seed
params.description: RNG seed for reproducible outputs. Gemini only; ignored for ElevenLabs.

params.name: with-vocals
params.description: Allow vocals in the output. Gemini only; ElevenLabs ignores this. Omit for instrumental-only, best under narration.

params.name: duration
params.description: Seconds. Required for elevenlabs (min 3). Gemini's longer track is trimmed to it with a fade-out, same codec; a shorter one is kept.
